title: You Think Resting Powers Down Your Brain, Yet Doing Nothing Burns Nearly All Its Fuel
description:
You think resting quietly powers down your brain! Yet doing nothing burns nearly all its fuel! This is the true story of neurologist Marcus Raichle's discovery. Here is what went wrong with early brain scans.
